# Rubi rule snapshot (C2 step 1)

A pinned extract from the Rubi rule base (MIT, see LICENSE;
(c) 2018 Rule-Based-Integration Organization) used as the parser
development corpus. Full upstream:
https://github.com/RuleBasedIntegration/Rubi

Current coverage of tools/rubi_parse.py over the FULL upstream tree
(221 .m files, 9 rule chapters): 165 files / 5501 rules parse into
the JSON IR; the remaining classes are catalogued in
notes/c1-algebraic-layer.md (item 24).
